entities.summary: Hyacinth Oroko Egbebo, MSP is a Nigerian Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Bomadi since 2017. Before Bomadi became a diocese that year, he served as Apostolic Vicar of Bomadi and Titular Bishop of Lacubaza. He has also served as superior general of the Missionary Society of Saint Paul of Nigeria.
